Podkręć po tylu walkach na tej samej:: Push depth after this many fights on the same depth:
Tryby maksymalne: gdy tyle walk z rzędu: Maximum modes: when this many fights in a row are at the same depth (read from the fight header), the bot checks / pushes the depth at once
Po każdej walce, przed JUST LOOT: tyle s: After each fight, before JUST LOOT: this many quick clicks on the "›" arrow (higher depth). At the maximum unlocked depth the arrow is dimmed and the bot does not click it. Does not work with fixed depth or maximum minus X%.
When the chosen depth drops to 1 (e.g. the game switched the loadout to HUNT), the bot picks the loadout with this name in Profile
Bot wchodzi w Profile → CHOOSE DEPTH i u: The bot goes to Profile → CHOOSE DEPTH and sets the depth: it taps the tile with the number (up to 79) or the ‹ › arrows (80+). It checks it right after the change and then every set interval - in automatic modes it also raises it when you unlock more or gear improves. If the entered depth is not unlocked, the nearest possible one is used. This setting is separate for each instance.
Otwieraj paczki, gdy gear jest za słaby: Open packs when gear is too weak
Bot sprawdza w Profile, czy wrogowie są: The bot checks in Profile whether enemies are "stronger" (gear too weak for the depth), or reacts to a streak of defeats - then in Craft it opens the maximum number of packs until gear is enough or the dust runs out.
Po tylu porażkach z rzędu:: After this many defeats in a row:
Jedna runda = maksymalna liczba paczek +: One round = the maximum number of packs + reviewing the cards
Ile paczek otworzyć za jednym razem. 0 =: How many packs to open in one go. 0 = rounds of up to 20 packs, until enemies return to normal strength / the dust runs out
Paczki, gdy głębokość walki (nagłówek wa: Packs when the fight depth (fight header) >= Gear Level (Profile) + this. 55 = the threshold from which enemies get a bonus
Gdy ekwipunek pełny – rozbieraj przedmio: When the inventory is full – salvage items
Po „Inventory Full”: OK, przytrzymanie S: After "Inventory Full": OK, hold Salvage on the drop screen, then in Inventory hold "+x DUST" on items FROM THE TOP OF THE LIST - set the sorting in the game so the weakest are on top (e.g. Item Level ascending). Salvaging cannot be undone.
Brązowe kafelki „TAP” - bot klika wszyst: Brown "TAP" tiles - the bot taps them all before the time runs out.
Celowanie: bot śledzi wskaźnik przez kil: Aiming: the bot tracks the indicator for a few frames, works out its movement and presses CAST so it stops in the middle of the bright zone. After each cast it checks where the indicator stopped and corrects the delay itself - the first casts may miss, then it hits. Works best with the scrcpy image.
Każda wartość jest losowana z zakresu \": Each value is drawn from the "from–to" range so the rhythm is not mechanical. The same "from" and "to" = fixed value.
⚡ Tryb turbo – maksymalna szybkość (igno: ⚡ Turbo mode – maximum speed (ignores the settings below)
Minimalne przerwy i czas reakcji, krótki: Minimum breaks and reaction time, short drags (approx. 0.2–0.3 s), no deliberate mistakes, other fixed breaks ~3× shorter. The settings below are kept and come back when turbo is off.
Przeciąganie kulek, przytrzymanie na DRO: Dragging balls, holding on DROP and breaks between drags
Czas reakcji na nowy ekran, kafelki mini: Reaction time on a new screen, minigame tiles and other breaks between actions
Odstęp między tapnięciami JUST LOOT w wa: Interval between JUST LOOT taps in a fight and tap length
Suwaki mnożą czasy poniżej (i w turbo):: Sliders multiply the times below (and in turbo): 200 % = times half as long, 50 % = twice as long. Dragging and holding on DROP do not go below the minimum at which the ball still lands. Game times (fight, animations, loading) do not change.
Ile palec stoi na DROP przed puszczeniem: How long the finger stays on DROP before release - the game moves the ball behind the finger with a delay; too short = the ball lands before the centre of DROP
Pomyłka = puszczenie kulki tuż obok DROP: A mistake = releasing the ball just next to DROP or clicking beside a tile. The bot corrects it at once, so it costs only a moment, while 100% accuracy looks inhuman. Times are drawn more often near the lower bound, sometimes longer - like a human.
Gdzie na kulce bot łapie palcem: 0 % = z:
Where on the ball the bot grabs with its finger: 0 % = always the centre of the ball,
100 % = randomly up to its edge.
Ustaw liczbę punktów toru ręcznie: Set the number of path points manually
Wyłączone = liczba punktów zależy od dłu: Off = the number of points depends on the length of the ball path.
Ile punktów pośrednich ma tor jednego pr:
How many intermediate points one drag path has - each is a separate finger movement.
Few points = simpler, "jerky" movement; many = smoother, longer gesture.
Gdzie nad DROP bot puszcza kulkę: 0 % =:
Where above DROP the bot releases the ball: 0 % = always the centre of DROP,
100 % = randomly up to its edge.
Palec jedzie po losowej krzywej, przyspi: The finger moves along a random curve, speeds up and slows down, grabs the ball at a random spot, and collects the balls in random order. Off: straight line centre–centre, balls in order.
scrcpy: emulator wysyła obraz jako wideo: scrcpy: the emulator sends the image as video already scaled to the analysis width - the frame is ready immediately. The game runs at normal resolution. If the stream fails, the bot briefly switches to screencap.
Zrzut ekranu jest przed analizą pomniejs: The screenshot is scaled down to this width before analysis - at 1080×1920 and 540 px the bot uses about 3× less CPU, and recognition works the same. Clicks land at full resolution. To reduce the load further: lower resolution (e.g. 540×960) and FPS (e.g. 30) in the LDPlayer settings.
Każdy punkt to obszar - bot klika w loso: Each point is an area - the bot clicks a random spot inside the circle. "Pick" and click on the preview (the preview needs an image - run the bot or "Refresh preview"). The areas are drawn on the preview while this tab is open.
Klikaj punkt awaryjny, gdy bot nic nie r: Click the emergency point when the bot recognizes nothing
Domyślnie wyłączone: na nieznanym ekrani: Off by default: on an unknown screen the bot clicks nothing (blind clicking may hit something random), it only saves a screenshot after a while (Protection tab).
Przywróć wartość zmierzoną na LDPlayer: Restore the value measured on LDPlayer
Klikaj JUST LOOT (bot sam go znajduje): Click JUST LOOT (the bot finds it itself)
Bot na każdej klatce szuka przycisku JUS:
On every frame the bot looks for the JUST LOOT button, and after a fight for PROCEED.
When it does not recognize the screen it clicks nothing (unless you enable the emergency point in the Points tab).
Jak daleko od środka przycisku bot może:
How far from the button centre the bot may click: 0 % = always the centre,
100 % = randomly up to the edge of the JUST LOOT button.
Na ekranie porównania przedmiotów bot kl: On the item comparison screen the bot clicks the chosen option. It opens the hidden card ("tap anywhere to reveal") on its own.
Zwykle niepotrzebny - wykrywanie działa: Usually not needed - detection works on the whole screen. It limits the ball search to a rectangle (e.g. on a very weak computer). All zeros = whole screen.
Przeciągnij potem prostokąt na podglądzi: Then drag a rectangle on the preview
